prompt:
You maintain a running summary of a long engineering document that is being read part by part, so that a later reader can model the system in SysML v2 without seeing the earlier parts.
Update the summary with the new part. Keep, as compactly as possible: the full names of system elements, actors and items; every alias or call sign with the full name it stands for; which element produces, sends or receives which item; modes and normative requirements. At most 300 words.

Current summary:
Cedar Falls Municipal Drinking Water Treatment Plant excludes distribution. Aliases: River Intake Pump Station=Ironwood; High Service Pump Header=Juniper; Coagulant Dosing Skid=Marigold; North Filter Gallery=Cobalt; Laboratory Sample Receiving Bench=Sparrow; Maintenance Planner=Quarry; Distribution Dispatcher=Falcon; SCADA Historian Server=Lantern. Producers→items: Raw Water Screen Channel→Rake Torque Snapshot; Marigold→Alum Batch Ticket; Laboratory Technician→Sample Chain Slip; Sparrow→checked Jar Test Photograph Set; South Filter Gallery→Filter Run Exception Note; Clearwell Level Controller→verified Clearwell Diver Entry Permit; Juniper→Pump Bearing Vibration Clip; Chemical Supplier Driver→Chlorine Cylinder Seal Log; Chief Operator→verified Backwash Solids Manifest; Falcon→verified Pressure Zone Handoff Card. Sparrow receives custody-controlled samples/returns status; Lantern retains slip-linked records. Quarry verifies isolation/reviews maintenance; Duty Engineer reviews seals before acceptance. Chief Operator authorizes Storm Intake Mode/priorities/post-incident reviews. Intake permissive-loss stops/alarms; unreliable dosing holds approved dose; filter/Backwash Recovery Tank recovery requires verification; Chlorine Residual Alarm pauses maintenance. Backup-power/UPS support safe operation/shutdown; dual-loss emergency notifies Chief Operator/Duty Engineer. Engineer-approved bounded workarounds logged/removed after restoration. Require sensor-failure detection,communications redundancy,recoverable/tested backups,least-privilege accounts; laboratory access excludes controls. Commissioning shall verify local/supervisory responses: Ironwood,screen channel,Cobalt,South Filter Gallery,Marigold; Juniper startup/lead-lag/shutdown pressure stability; Lantern synchronization/tags/retention/trend retrieval; Chlorine Contact Basin/level-controller level/flow/residual before release. Drill Storm Intake Mode prompts/constraints/normal-return; test residual-alarm annunciation/guidance/acknowledgement/escalation. Chief Operator coordinates sequencing/fallback/alarm training through classroom/practice/walkdowns/supervised-service; Laboratory Technician learns timing/entry/review/unusual-findings communication. Quarry reviews defects/nuisance-alarms/drift/access before maintenance intervals; uses clip for condition/inspection/priorities; operations reviews work-order feedback against masked degradation/field effort. Readiness requires pressure/storage/communications/emergency-path verification; Falcon confirms message acknowledgement before zone changes; South Distribution Pressure Station uses card for zone/valves/communications;

New part:
S246: The Chemical Supplier Driver shall follow site access, unloading, verification, and communication procedures established during commissioning and confirmed during training.
S247: Records generated during commissioning and early operation shall be complete enough to support troubleshooting, regulatory review, warranty claims, and future operator training.
S248: Records retention shall follow municipal policy and applicable drinking water requirements, with electronic records protected against unauthorized change and accidental loss.
S249: Periodic performance reviews shall compare actual plant operation with the control concept, including alarm burden, manual interventions, water quality stability, chemical use, and energy use.
S250: Continuous improvement actions shall be prioritized by risk, reviewed by the Chief Operator and Duty Engineer, tested before release, and incorporated into updated procedures and training materials.

Return JSON {"summary": "..."}.
